stem: Which sentence from the selection best conveys the author’s admiration for Ma’s accomplishments?

options.label: F
options.text: He loved his new life and played the cello all the time.

options.label: G
options.text: He has also been a guest on children's shows like Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

options.label: H
options.text: Ma has established Silk Road programs in schools around the nation.

options.label: J
options.text: Ma’s many contributions to the arts clearly mark him as a very good musician indeed.
